_provenance: Published from laquereric/iq@8a23887b59dbea2c295b68bfbe84b55f83c2e653, Development/UseCase/UC_GameSurface/cid/game-pull.cid.json, so the seam's CID is fetchable outside a private repo (rule 10).
description: Read access to game sessions: catalog, session summary, structured observation, and the input log since a cursor (polling, since CPCP has no subscriptions). Reads cost nothing and promise nothing.

operations.result: @graph of GameSim: sim id, tickHz, closed action table

GameSession: sim, seed, driver, tick, hash, over, inputs count, log (the log's length: a reader's look); prev and next, the games before and after this one (session.rematch, slice 28); on co-play, lanes {seat, held, holder (who holds it, slice 36), open, away, through, awayMs (while away), quietMs (while closed: since its writer's channel shut or the seam loaded the game, slice 35)} and releaseMs (slice 30)
Observation: the sim's observe() output plus the state hash. This is what an agent gets instead of pixels.
InputLog: seed, sim, tick, hash, next cursor, and inputs[cursor:]. A viewer re-simulates locally; state never travels.

params.sim: string (optional): only games of this sim
params.here: boolean (optional): this seam's games alone, as a peer asks
params.mine: boolean (optional, slice 31): the caller's own games instead

operations.result: OpenGames {@graph: OpenGame {session, sim, seats, seated, players (slice 36), seam, since}}: games waiting for a player -- co-play, not over, a seat free, and someone in it (a lane open, or made in the last GAME_WAIT_MS) -- longest waiting first, this seam's and each peer's (GAME_PEERS, asked as the caller). Slice 26. With mine: true, MyGames {@graph: MyGame {session, sim, seats, seated, seat, open, tick, seam, used}}: the caller's own games -- co-play, not over, not followed by a next game, a seat of the caller's -- most recently in use first, on this seam and its peers; answered from memory, so a game no seam has touched for GAME_IDLE_MS is not listed. Slice 31. Then the caller's games no seam holds, from the store (its side of every seat record; a game over or followed by a next one left out), each loaded: false with no tick or lane, at the seam its last claim names, at most GAME_MINE_MAX. Slice 32.

params.session: string (required): any game of the table

operations.result: Series {session, game (this one's place), games, truncated?, @graph: SeriesGame {game, session, seed, tick, score, over, hash, next}}: the chain of rematches through this game, first to last, each as it was played -- live while the seam holds it, else as it stood when its next game was made. The others are read from their records alone: none is loaded or claimed. At most GAME_SERIES_MAX games either way. Slice 29.
